# n8nkit — Codebase Summary

**Last Updated:** 2026-07-07
**Source commit:** 31649d0
**Generated by:** /docs-init
**approx_tokens:** ~1500

## Là gì
`n8nkit` = **n8n workflow engineering toolkit cho Claude Code**, đóng gói dưới dạng **Claude Code plugin** (version 0.5.0). Gồm ~20 lifecycle/knowledge skills + 2 specialist agents + 4 real-time guard hooks + shared utility + workflow templates. Mirror triết lý ClaudeKit (problem-first, YAGNI, specialist routing, artifact-gated phases, real-time guardrails) áp cho domain n8n.

## Tech stack
- **KHÔNG có package.json/pyproject** — không phải Node/Python build project. Phân phối qua Claude Code plugin (`/plugin marketplace add` + `/plugin install`), không npm publish.
- Ngôn ngữ: Markdown (56 files — skills/agents/docs, phần lớn), `.cjs` Node CommonJS (6 — hooks + test harness, self-contained chỉ dùng `fs`/`path`/`os`/`child_process`), `.ps1` PowerShell (6 — install/migrate/verify/rollback), `.sh` (2 — E2E), `.js` (1 — shared backup helper), `.json` (config/templates/hooks manifest).
- Runtime: Node.js (hooks chạy `node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/*.cjs"`).
- Dep vận hành ngoài (không bundle, gọi qua shell): `@trngthnh369/n8nctl` (CLI backbone, v1.4) + `@trngthnh369/n8n-workflow-validator` — dự án chị em ở `D:\Projects\personal\n8nctl`.

## Entry points
- **Plugin bootstrap**: `/plugin marketplace add D:\Projects\personal\n8nkit` → `/plugin install n8nkit@n8nkit-marketplace` (đăng ký qua `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json`).
- **Enable per-project**: `enabledPlugins` trong `.claude/settings.local.json` của project dùng nó (gotcha "sticky-false" — xem NOTES-followups.md).
- **Slash commands** (auto-trigger theo description + namespaced `/n8nkit:n8n-*`): `/n8n-intake`, `/n8n-build`, `/n8n-review`, `/n8n-deploy`, `/n8n-test`, `/n8n-fix`, `/n8n-rollback`, `/n8n-monitor`, `/n8n-promote`, `/n8n-credentials`, `/n8n-docs`.
- **Fallback router**: `skills/n8n-pipeline/SKILL.md` — trigger khi intent mơ hồ, bản đồ điều hướng 19 skill.
- **Operator scripts** (không phải user entry): `scripts/install.ps1`, `migrate-to-plugin.ps1`, `verify-plugin.ps1`, `test-hooks.cjs` (62 assertions), `e2e-fix-loop.sh` / `e2e-prod-sample.sh` (cần session auth thật).

## Module map
| Thư mục | Vai trò | File quan trọng |
|---|---|---|
| `.claude-plugin/` | Plugin manifest | `plugin.json` (v0.4.1), `marketplace.json` |
| `skills/` (19) | Progressive-disclosure skills, mỗi folder 1 `SKILL.md` + reference `.md` phụ | `n8n-pipeline/` (router), `n8n-build`, `n8n-deploy`, `n8n-fix`, `n8n-review/LENSES.md`, `n8n-code-javascript/*`, `n8nctl/` |
| `agents/` | 2 specialist subagents | `n8n-builder.md` (greenfield JSON), `n8n-debugger.md` (runtime forensics + self-heal) |
| `hooks/` | 4 deterministic guard hooks (self-contained `.cjs`) + manifest | `_lib.cjs`, `pre-n8n-secret-guard.cjs`, `pre-bash-n8n-prod-guard.cjs`, `post-n8n-validate.cjs`, `post-bash-n8nctl-diagnose.cjs`, `secret-patterns.json`, `hooks.json` |
| `.n8nkit/` | Config-driven path resolution + schema | `config.json` (workflowRoot/templatesDir…), `config.schema.json` |
| `shared/` | Utility JS | `n8n-backup-manifest.js` |
| `templates/` | Workflow JSON skeleton theo tier + project bootstrap | `orchestrator/hub/utility.template.json`, `project-bootstrap/CLAUDE.md.template` |
| `scripts/` | Install/migrate/verify/rollback + test + E2E | `test-hooks.cjs`, `verify-plugin.ps1` |
| `docs/` | Living docs (không sinh từ code) | `HANDOFF-next.md` (roadmap W1-W3), `NOTES-followups.md` (gotcha log) |

## Data flow (tóm tắt — chi tiết xem system-architecture.md)
User prompt → Claude auto-trigger skill theo description → SKILL.md hướng dẫn gọi `n8nctl` CLI (không gọi REST trực tiếp) → PreToolUse hooks chặn trước Write/Edit/Bash (secret-guard + prod-guard fail-closed) → PostToolUse hooks validate/diagnose → skill sau consume artifact skill trước (cross-skill handoff).

## Trạng thái
**Pre-publish, đang active dev** (v0.4.1). `docs/HANDOFF-next.md`: còn treo W1 `/n8n-cook` orchestrator, W2 đồng bộ n8nctl 1.4, W3 publish GitHub/npm. Git tags local semver-ish, chưa push remote thật.

## sensitive_sources_excluded
Không đọc nội dung file secret. Các file tên "secret/credential" (`hooks/pre-n8n-secret-guard.cjs`, `hooks/secret-patterns.json`, `skills/n8n-credentials/`, `skills/n8n-promote/CREDENTIAL-MAPPING.md`) là **code/skill logic xử lý secret**, không phải secret value — an toàn. Không phát hiện `.env`/token value trong repo.
